title: vfsim — Vehicle Flow Simulator
description: Describe a place and a change in plain language and vfsim simulates the area twice with the same seed, as it is and with your change. An LLM agent builds the scenario, a map editor adds flyovers, closures and signals, and an IDM/MOBIL engine replays both runs side by side with metrics.

title: RL Portfolio Allocation
description: PPO and DDPG agents learn daily portfolio weights over 100 anonymized assets, tuned with Optuna and benchmarked against equal weight. Built on a technical-indicator feature panel, with a LightGBM next-close forecast and feature-correlation pair scores.

title: Research Paper RAG
description: A RAG system that ingests research papers into a vector database and uses the retrieved context for LLM inference. The agent and vector store are connected; an ingestion API is still to come.
